text:
Sam T: Heads up — sampleapp produced duplicated outputs when a 429 hit coincided with OIDC refresh. Repro is short and ugly.

Sam T: Flow:
1) client sends request R (body ~120KB)
2) server returns 429
3) SDK kicks retry backoff immediately (short jitter)
4) meanwhile auth refresh completes and original logical operation is re-issued -> server gets two distinct requests (no idempotency header)

Noah L: That's rough. Does our SDK set any operation-scoped id by default? I thought only higher-level wrappers did.

Ivy W: No, we don't. Node team added a manual idempotency header in onboarding sample, but it's not standard. Parity gap.

Sam T: Proposal 1: introduce a minimal "replay-seq" header that's opaque (UUID) set at request construction time and preserved across retries and refresh. Server can use it for dedupe. Keep header name short and generic: `Replay-Id`.

Noah L: Proposal 2: middleware that detects auth-refresh start and gates retries for that logical op. If refresh in-flight, first retry should back off to at least refreshEstimatedMs + small jitter. That prevents overlap.

Ivy W: Both sound ok. Also want to tune jitter: current fixed jitter sometimes makes retry fire before refresh completes. Suggest payload-aware jitter formula: jitter_ms = base_ms * (1 + ln(1 + payload_kb)). Keeps small payloads low latency, larger payloads spread more.

Sam T: Good variation from sqrt. We need consistency across SDKs. Suggest implementing the algorithm in sdk-core (tiny module) and expose config: { replayEnabled: true, baseJitterMs: 75, replayHeader: 'Replay-Id', conservativeOnboarding: true }

Noah L: Instrumentation is important. Add telemetry events: replay.generated, replay.sent-before-refresh, replay.deduped-server. That helps us spot regressions and how often servers rely on idempotency.

Ivy W: For onboarding sampleapp, include server dedupe snippet and show how to infer duplicates via `replay.deduped-server` + HTTP 200 with body { duplicate: true }. Also add a test harness that simulates: 429 -> refresh 250ms -> retry land times at 100ms and 400ms -> assert single accept.

replay-bot: (automated) Created TICKET-705: "Replay-Id header + refresh-aware retry gating + payload-jitter + telemetry + sampleapp demo".

Sam T: Edgecases: what about streaming requests? For streaming we can't resend whole stream easily. Maybe mark streaming ops as non-replayable unless user opt-in. Add `replayable: boolean` flag on request builder.

Noah L: Server-side dedupe also needs expiry window; add guidance: keep Replay-Id cache for min(max(1s, estimated processing time * 2), 30s). Document in sampleapp README.

Ivy W: I'll draft PR for Node middleware, example server, and e2e. Noah can draft the spec for Go/Python parity and telemetry mapping. Sam will own SDK-core module.

Sam T: I'll mock the e2e using the existing local test server and post results. Will include bench of how different jitter formulas affect latency for small (<1KB) vs large (200KB) payloads.

Noah L: Sounds good. Quick thumbs if you agree with Replay-Id + refresh gating as default for safeReplay mode.

Ivy W: :thumbsup:
Noah L: :thumbsup:
Sam T: :thumbsup:
